Name: Universal Seed Converter
Author: SVslimeStudio
Description:
Description
[b]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/b] Turn almost any item in Stardew Valley into plantable seeds! This mod allows you to use the standard vanilla Seed Maker to refine crops, fish, monster loot, artifacts, forage, minerals, and many other items into custom seeds.
How It Works
Place any non-tool item into a standard Seed Maker and wait 12 in-game hours. The machine will process it and produce a seed that grows into the very item you inserted. The seed retains the original item's quality – silver, gold, or iridium quality items will produce seeds of the same quality.
Main features
[b]Describe the core features of your mod[/b]
[list]
[*][b]1000+ items supported[/b] – Almost every item in the game can be converted into seeds, with no manual configuration needed.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic growth time[/b] – Growth duration is automatically calculated based on the item's value (8–90 days). Cheap items grow faster, while expensive items take longer.[/*]
[*][b]All-season crops[/b] – Seeds created by this mod grow in any season and never wither, whether planted outdoors, in the Greenhouse, or on Ginger Island.[/*]
[*][b]Giant crop support[/b] – Every seed has a chance to grow into a giant crop version of the original item.[/*]
[*][b]Quality retention[/b] – Silver, gold, and iridium quality items produce seeds of the same quality.[/*]
[*][i](Note: The custom "Universal Seed Converter" machine previously sold at Pierre's for 1,000,000g is now obsolete—simply use the standard Seed Maker directly!)[/i][/*]
[/list]Requirements
[b]Provide info on additional required steps, resources, or mods[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Installation instructions
[b]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Compatibility
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Compatible with most other mods.[/*]
[/list]Shout outs
[b]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/b] Special thanks to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley, the Pathoschild and SMAPI community for their amazing modding tools, and everyone testing and supporting this mod!
